# WorldAtlas

> > WorldAtlas is a comprehensive geography education resource providing world maps, country data, continental information, and geographic reference materials.

Founded by John Moen and operated by Reunion Technology Inc., WorldAtlas serves as a trusted educational platform for geographic information. The site features detailed country profiles with flags, ISO codes, economic data, and comprehensive coverage of continents, states, and world geography, maintained by an editorial team including Marek Brys, Oishimaya Sen Nag, and other geography experts.

## Key Topics

- World Geography
- Country Data & Statistics
- Continents (Asia, Africa, Americas, Europe, Australia, Antarctica)
- World Maps & Flags
- ISO Country Codes
- GDP & Population Data
- USA States & Abbreviations
- Geography Education
- Country Profiles
- Geographic Reference Materials
- ZIP Code Systems
- Editorial Team (Marek Brys, Oishimaya Sen Nag, John Moen)
- Reunion Technology Inc.

## Geographic Reference & Maps

- [List of Maps with Flags and Country Codes](https://www.worldatlas.com/maps): Complete country list with flags, ISO codes, GDP, and population data
- [Continents Of The World](https://www.worldatlas.com/continents): Overview of 7 continents: Asia, Africa, Americas, Antarctica, Europe, Australia
- [USA States (Two-Letter Abbreviations)](https://www.worldatlas.com/geography/usa-states.html): USPS two-letter state codes and ZIP code system reference guide

## About WorldAtlas

- [About Us - WorldAtlas](https://www.worldatlas.com/about): About WorldAtlas, founded by John Moen and Reunion Technology Inc.
- [WorldAtlas.com](https://www.worldatlas.com/about.htm): Company info and editorial team including Marek Brys and Oishimaya Sen Nag
